messages:
toni: Heads up: published 5.2.0 and internal CI started failing. Services using require() can't load the package.

marta: Which package/entrypoint?

toni: `@redwood/sdk-web@5.2.0`. Error is `Cannot find module '.../dist/index.cjs'`. I ran `npm pack` and tar shows only `dist/index.mjs` + `dist/index.mjs.map` and types under `types/index.d.mts`.

sam: That explains it. Exports map still points require -> dist/index.cjs but no cjs file shipped. Also many TS projects expect `index.d.ts`, not `.d.mts`.

marta: Quick plan: publish patch 5.2.1 with dual outputs (cjs + esm) and classic d.ts. Add a release smoke check: `npm pack && tar -tf` must include `dist/index.cjs` and `types/index.d.ts`, and run a tiny node script that does both `require()` and dynamic `import()`.

toni: Workaround for teams: pin to 5.1.x or switch to import() on modern node. Both are annoying.

sam: Also fix `files` glob in package.json, it was `dist/*.mjs` which filtered out cjs and types. We'll revert that.

marta: Follow-ups: (1) PR to change rollup to emit two outputs rather than change ext globally, (2) add verify-publish to release job, (3) checklist entry "ensure cjs + esm + types + sourcemaps in npm pack".

devex-bot: Published @redwood/sdk-web@5.2.1 — contains cjs bundle, .d.ts, and updated exports map.

toni: Confirmed downstream CI green on 5.2.1. Thanks.

marta: Closing thread. Will add the verify script to the release workflow.
